extraction.Name: Mary Cordier Red Owl
extraction.Recorded patent: The patent was recorded July 19, 1920 by The Clanco Realty Company
extraction.Buyer: Sold by Mary Cordier Red Owl and her husband to N. A. Perebloom for $1.00 and other valuable consideration
extraction.NOTES: Fee patent No. 739620 issued; northeast quarter of section 17, township 38, range 28; receipt for patent signed by allottee April 2, 1920; land mortgaged July 10, 1920 for $2000.00; sold October 27, 1923
